newsitem.title: GREECE: GSEE V-PRES. MANOLIS WILL RUN ON ND PARTY TICKET.
newsitem.headline: GSEE V-PRES. MANOLIS WILL RUN ON ND PARTY TICKET.

text.p: Yannis Manolis, vice-president at the General Confederation of Greek Workers Union (GSEE) will be a candidate with the conservative New Democracy (ND) Party in the second district of Athens, he told Reuters.

Manolis, a member of the social and economic committee, is also a leading figure of the conservative DAKE union and an advisor of ND party president Miltiadis Evert on labour issues. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
